sections.heading: DIT University vs Quantum University for MA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose DIT University if you want recorded year tuition of ₹1,52,500 for MA Clinical Psychology, or ₹82,500 for MA English and MA Economics, after official confirmation.
Choose Quantum University if you want recorded year tuition of ₹50,000 for MA English and MA Economics at the Roorkee campus, after official confirmation.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For DIT University we hold year tuition of ₹1,52,500 for Master of Arts Clinical Psychology, and ₹82,500 for English and for Economics. These are year figures, not confirmed official programme totals.
For Quantum University we hold year tuition of ₹50,000 for MA English and MA Economics.
Confirm the current notices on dituniversity.edu.in and quantumuniversity.edu.in before you budget.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: DIT University is recorded in Dehradun. Quantum University is recorded in Roorkee, even though its profile slug mentions Dehradun. They are not the same city.
Both are private universities. DIT University also lists clinical psychology, which Quantum does not list on this page. Match the subject first.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick DIT University if clinical psychology, or the Dehradun campus, is the goal, after official fee confirmation.
Pick Quantum University if MA English or Economics in Roorkee and the recorded ₹50,000 year tuition fit you, after official confirmation.
